description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AttributeIncentiveCalculation within the package for interest rate chart incentives. It includes an abstract method for calculating incentives and a concrete method to determine whether an incentive should be applied based on certain conditions.

classes.name: AttributeIncentiveCalculation
classes.description: An abstract class responsible for incentive calculation logic, including applying conditions to determine whether an incentive should be granted.

methods.name: calculateIncentive
methods.description: Abstract method to calculate the incentive based on an IncentiveDTO object.
